summary: Material library file lookup and texture resource creation. Tries three strategies in order: direct open of the given filename a2, then iterating registered entry path prefixes (byte_8B5A3C, stride 132, count dword_8B8E30), then walking a linked list from head dword_8B8F14. For each located file it calls D3DTextureResourceCreation and closes the handle. If a list-entry count mismatch (v9 != dword_8B6AC0) occurs it returns 0; if no file is located it formats and reports an "Unable to locate material lib" message via sub_53C590 and returns -1.

operations.description: Attempt direct open of filename a2 with binary read mode from global aRb via sub_587DB0(a2, aRb).
If the direct open returned a non-zero handle v3, proceed to texture creation path.
Call D3DTextureResourceCreation(this, 0) to create the texture resource from the opened file.
FileCloseWithLock(v3) closes the direct-open handle; on texture creation failure return -1.
Return 0 after closing the handle when texture creation succeeded.
Iterate the registered entry path array byte_8B5A3C, count dword_8B8E30, advancing each entry by stride 132.
StringFormatWithBufferOverflowCheck(v11, "%s\\%s", entryPath, a2) builds the candidate full path.
sub_587DB0(v11, aRb) attempts to open each formatted candidate path.
First successful open in the loop breaks iteration.
For a loop-found file, D3DTextureResourceCreation(this, 0) then FileCloseWithLock(v7); return -1 on creation failure.
When no registered path matched, compare entry count v5 to dword_8B8E30 and fall through to linked-list walk.
Walk the linked list from head dword_8B8F14, advancing each node by 304 bytes, testing nodes with sub_560230(a2).
D3DTextureResourceCreation(this, 0) for a matching list entry; return -1 on creation failure.
If the visited count v9 does not equal dword_8B6AC0, return 0 immediately.
Early return 0 when the list-entry count does not match dword_8B6AC0.
StringFormatWithBufferOverflowCheck(v11, "Unable to locate material lib %s", a2) then sub_53C590(-1, v11) reports the failure.
Return -1 after reporting that the material library could not be located.

unresolved: The exact role and stride layout of the entry path array byte_8B5A3C are derived from the array walk, not independently confirmed.
The node meaning of the linked list headed at dword_8B8F14 and the semantics of the 304-byte link field are unknown.
The semantics of the count comparison against dword_8B6AC0 (why a mismatch returns success 0) are not explained by the raw source.
